description:
Let's build a playable browser game for your NASA Space Apps Challenge team, Mission Nebula, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. You can develop it on your Android phone, without needing a PC.
The player will drive a rover across Mars, explore the terrain, collect scientific samples, avoid rocks, and complete mission objectives. We'll start with a working 3D prototype and add more realistic features afterward.
summary:
Mission Nebula Crew is a space exploration game where players get to experience the journey of a space mission. The game starts with a rocket launch from Earth and takes players on an exciting journey through space, exploring different environments, entering orbit, and travelling towards Mars.
Our main goal is to make learning about space more fun and interactive through gaming. Players can experience different stages of a space mission while learning about space exploration, planets, and how astronauts travel beyond Earth.
Mission Nebula combines education, science, and gaming to create an exciting space adventure.
details: Mission Nebula Crew – NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 Mission Nebula Crew is a 3D space exploration and simulation game created to make learning about space more exciting and interactive. Our project is designed around four game modes: Space Exploration, Mars Rover Mission, Space Combat and Solar System Exploration. Players can experience a space journey, launch rockets from Earth, explore space, control a Mars rover and discover different planets. Our main objective is to combine education, science and gaming in one platform. We want to encourage students and space enthusiasts to learn about the universe through an enjoyable gaming experience. Our vision: Explore beyond Earth, discover the unknown and make space learning fun for everyone. Mission Nebula Crew – Explore Beyond Limits!
